consentPrinciples.rule: The emergency may teach clinical mechanics. Rohan’s identity, voice, and authored framing require consent.
Personalised symptom language belongs to Rohan’s authorship — not free promotional copy.
Raw AAC logs and private conversations are not routine evidence or marketing content.
A public location does not make a medical crisis public property.
Family fear is serious; it does not authorise continuous video or seizure of Rohan’s privacy.
Training cuts that strip communication, delirium, restraint, school, home staffing, or privacy need renewed consent.

activePrinciples.text: ICU begins only after the resuscitation bay restored sustained circulation — not in the library or ambulance.
Unavailable or slow communication is an access issue — never incapacity by itself.
Address Rohan directly. Family and friends are not default answerers or unpaid responders.
Tracheostomy and controlled ventilation are support — not defeat or a victory condition to reverse.
Airway and emergency labour stay with paid trained responders. Parents and Jay are not the clinical roster.
Rohan’s identity, voice, and authored framing require consent — including story and training use.
